notes: Reads supported local session JSONL files under ~/.codex/sessions.
Reads ~/.codex/history.jsonl when present.

limitations: Exact supported JSONL is manual-importable. `.jsonl.zst` is detected unsupported; SQLite, past roots, and the default beside an override are excluded.

notes: Reads Pi session JSONL files under ~/.pi/agent/sessions, including per-cwd session directories produced by current Pi releases.

limitations: One-shot/API, untrusted or past project, moved, and OMP roots require exact `--path`. One root wins; no ancestor scan or default union.

notes: Reads Claude Code project JSONL transcripts under ~/.claude/projects, including nested subagent transcripts when present.

notes: Reads OpenCode SQLite history from ~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db using a read-only connection.

history_locations: Winner: `$OPENCODE_DB` or `${XDG_DATA_HOME:-~/.local/share}/opencode/opencode.db`.
limitations: `:memory:` means no disk history. Retained channels and nonselected defaults are manual-only.

notes: Reads Kilo Code SQLite history using the OpenCode-family SQLite normalizer against a read-only connection.
KILO_DB overrides the database path; relative KILO_DB values resolve under the Kilo XDG data directory.
When KILO_DB is not set, ctx selects the single active Kilo database; legacy opencode.db is considered only when the current database is absent.

history_locations: Winner: `$KILO_DB` or active DB under `${XDG_DATA_HOME:-~/.local/share}/kilo`; paired legacy `opencode.db` only when current is absent.
limitations: `:memory:` means no disk history. Channels/platform defaults are not unioned, nor are current and legacy.

notes: Reads MiMo Code SQLite history using the OpenCode-family SQLite normalizer against a read-only connection.
Selects one database by $MIMOCODE_DB, $MIMOCODE_HOME/data/mimocode.db, or the XDG/default mimocode.db path, in that order.

history_locations: Winner: `$MIMOCODE_DB`, `$MIMOCODE_HOME/data/mimocode.db`, or `${XDG_DATA_HOME:-~/.local/share}/mimocode/mimocode.db`, in order.
limitations: `:memory:` means no disk history. Inactive channels and defaults beside an override are manual-only.

notes: Reads Kiro CLI SQLite history from data.sqlite3 using a read-only connection.
The official 2.10.0 Linux binary created $XDG_DATA_HOME/kiro-cli/data.sqlite3 with conversations_v2(key, conversation_id, value, created_at, updated_at) and conversations(key, value).
Conversation payload parsing covers value.history[] entries with user Prompt text, assistant Response text, and assistant ToolUse content/tool_uses.

history_locations: Detected unsupported: `${KIRO_HOME:-~/.kiro}/sessions`. Legacy platform `kiro-cli/data.sqlite3` is automatic only when current history is absent.
limitations: ACP/v3 and saved-chat JSON are unsupported. Exact legacy SQLite is manual-importable; current and legacy are never unioned.

notes: Reads Crush SQLite history from crush.db using a read-only connection.
Discovery checks CRUSH_GLOBAL_DATA, XDG data homes, configured data_directory values from crush.json, and project .crush directories.

history_locations: Winner: one `crush.db` from bounded config and nearest/default `.crush` inside the current Git/worktree boundary; finite registered projects may coexist.
limitations: Global config/data directories are not DBs. Unregistered flags and past CWDs require exact `--path`; no broad ancestor scan.

notes: Reads Goose sessions SQLite history from sessions/sessions.db using a read-only connection.
Discovery selects absolute GOOSE_PATH_ROOT or one current platform data-root strategy; retained alternate databases are not added.

limitations: Current and retained platform roots are not unioned. Moved/retained DBs require exact `--path`.

history_locations: One automatic `local.db` per finitely identified installed VS Code or JetBrains client, profile, and version.
limitations: Distinct installed clients may coexist. Migration/old settings, Visual Studio, remote, and unknown profiles require exact `--path`.

notes: Reads official Qoder transcript JSONL files under ~/.qoder/projects/<project>/transcript/<session-id>.jsonl.
Imports documented session_meta, user, assistant, progress, text, tool_use, and tool_result records.
Does not parse Qoder VS Code/Electron state databases or encrypted application logs.

history_locations: Detected unsupported at fixed SDK default: `~/.qoder/projects/<project>/*.jsonl` direct session files.
limitations: `QODER_CONFIG_DIR` is SDK-scoped and manual-only. Direct SDK JSONL stays unsupported with `--path`; legacy `transcript/*.jsonl` can be selected exactly.

notes: Native import for Warp Terminal local restoration SQLite databases; ctx import --all and search refresh include discovered documented local paths, and ctx import --provider warp --path <warp.sqlite> preserves explicit-path import.

Live SQLite handling uses a read-only query-only SQLite connection with normal WAL visibility; tests cover committed WAL content while a writer connection remains open.

history_locations: Winner: Linux `${XDG_STATE_HOME:-~/.local/state}/warp-terminal/warp.sqlite`, or fixed macOS/Windows DB per installed first-party surface.
limitations: Only installed coexisting surfaces are emitted. Historical roots, arbitrary builds, cloud history, and FreeBSD are manual/excluded.

notes: Reads CodeBuddy extension JSON history under recursive history/<md5(projectPath)> project directories.
Reads CodeBuddy Code CLI JSONL transcripts under ~/.codebuddy/projects/<workspace>/*.jsonl.
Session index.json lists messages; message bodies are read from messages/*.json and may contain stringified JSON.

limitations: The CLI override replaces default. One-shot and unregistered host/profile roots require exact `--path`.

Released compatibility remains available for exact explicit Trae or Trae CN User/workspaceStorage roots, workspace directories, or state.vscdb files.
Reads SQLite ItemTable values for exporter-backed keys including memento/icube-ai-agent-storage, icube-ai-agent-storage-input-history, chat.ChatSessionStore.index, and ChatStore.
Trae CN input-history rows are imported as user prompts when assistant replies are not present in local state.
globalStorage, arbitrary caches, unknown ItemTable keys, and full assistant transcript recovery from input-history-only databases are not claimed.

history_locations: ~/.config/Trae/ModularData/ai-agent/database.db
~/Library/Application Support/Trae/ModularData/ai-agent/database.db
%APPDATA%\Trae\ModularData\ai-agent\database.db
limitations: Automatic discovery locates only the current platform-standard database.db and never unions legacy workspaceStorage. Current encrypted relational chats are not importable; released plaintext ItemTable compatibility at that location is admitted, while User/workspaceStorage/state.vscdb remains exact `--path` only.

limitations: Current SQLite has no importer. Legacy JSONL, old profiles, `.moltbot`, mounts, and remotes are manual-only and not unioned.

notes: Reads Hermes Agent SQLite history from HERMES_HOME/state.db or ~/.hermes/state.db using a read-only SQLite connection.

limitations: Inactive profiles, API DBs, mounts, and unregistered installs require exact `--path`.

notes: Native importer for a NanoClaw project root containing data/v2.db and data/v2-sessions/*/*/{inbound.db,outbound.db}.

limitations: Missing service metadata returns after fixed exact lookups. Malformed, oversized, unsafe, mismatched, missing-checkout, or symlinked registration data is rejected fail-closed; no checkout/ancestor scan and no nohup/WSL wrapper discovery because that wrapper is checkout-local.

notes: Automatic importer for bounded AstrBot data/data_v4.db locations, covering durable conversation context plus available platform_message_history rows.
ctx reads conversations.content and platform_message_history; other platform-native non-LLM replies may remain stored on those IM platforms rather than in data_v4.db.

history_locations: Core winner: `$ASTRBOT_ROOT/data/data_v4.db`, exact-CWD `data/data_v4.db`, or Desktop `~/.astrbot/data/data_v4.db`; finite Launcher instances may coexist.
limitations: Ancestors, containers, and unknown installs are not guessed. Old CWDs and mounts require exact `--path`.

notes: Reads Shelley SQLite history from exact current-CWD shelley.db automatically or any supported database supplied by exact explicit path; SHELLEY_DB and helper defaults are not automatic selectors.
Normalizes conversations as sessions and messages as events with stable conversation/sequence/message cursors.
Indexes text from Shelley user/agent/tool JSON, including thinking, tool calls, and tool results when present.

limitations: `SHELLEY_DB`, helper defaults, server flags, past CWDs, and Windows guesses are manual-only; `~/.config/shelley/shelley.db` is no longer automatic.

Indexes message content, context item text, tool call names/status, and failed-output diagnostics when present.

history_locations: Winner: `$CONTINUE_GLOBAL_DIR/sessions` or `~/.continue/sessions`.
limitations: Override replaces default. Old process-relative roots are manual-only; editor webview state is not imported.

DbThread messages do not carry per-message timestamps; ctx uses the thread updated_at for imported event timestamps.
